batches of different sizes stay comparable. The flip side: it is one number, so one badly predicted token can hide among

D · The optimisation setup — and the three things it leaves out
What the training loop leaves out

The loop above is correct and will train this model. It also leaves out three things that serious training scripts have. Knowing which three — and why they can be skipped here — is most of the difference between reading a tutorial and writing one.
